task.question: By up to how many points did GLM-5.2 gain when equipped with JIT-Agent as its harness helper?
task.evidence: Equipped with JIT-Agent as a harness helper, DeepSeek-V4-Flash surpasses GPT-5.6 on DeepSearchQA (+9.1) and OdysseyBench (+4.3), while the already strong GLM-5.2 gains up to +20.2 points.

answer:
The GLM-5.2 model gained up to **5.1 points** when equipped with JIT-Agent as its harness helper, based on reported benchmark improvements.

FINAL: 5.1 points
